items.title: Motorola Solutions Lifts Outlook as Profit, Revenue Gain
items.summary: The Chicago-based company said it now expects full-year adjusted earnings between $17.62 and $17.72 a share on revenue of about $12.98 billion.

items.title: Goodyear Swings to Loss on Lower Tire Volume, Higher Costs
items.summary: The company posted a loss of $204 million, or 71 cents a share, compared with a profit of $254 million, or 87 cents a share, in the year-ago quarter.

items.title: DoorDash Profit Falls as Costs Offset Revenue Growth
items.summary: The decline in profit was driven by higher costs of revenue from more orders, as well as increases in sales, marketing, and research and development expenses and other overhead costs, the company said.

items.title: Western Digital Stock Tanks. An Earnings Beat Isn’t Enough.
items.summary: The hard-drive maker reports better-than-expected earnings for its fiscal fourth quarter, but guidance disappoints.

items.title: Sandisk Revenue Soars on AI Data Storage Demand
items.summary: The company posted a higher net income of $6.9 billion as the artificial-intelligence buildout continued to fuel demand for data storage.

items.title: Western Digital Profit Surges as Revenue Grows
items.summary: Western Digital reported a more than elevenfold increase in its fourth-quarter profit, driven by continued strong demand for its memory technology.

items.title: New York Times Stock Plunges 13% as Subscriber Growth Slows
items.summary: The  New York Times  reported higher profit and revenue for the second quarter, but its shares tumbled 13% as the company forecast slower subscriber growth in the current quarter.  The company said it added about 280,000 net digital-only subscribers from the prior quarter, its smallest sequential increase in a year.  It reported about 12.8 million in digital-only subscribers at the end of the quarter, and nearly 13.4 million total subscribers.
